questions.question: Under no circumstances ___ the data be altered.
Under no circumstances ___ confidential data be shared.
Rarely, if ever, ___ such confidential data be shared.
questions.explanation: Negative or restrictive fronted expressions can trigger subject–auxiliary inversion.

questions.question: At no point during the review ___ the rules be ignored.
questions.explanation: Negative fronted adverbials such as at no point trigger subject–auxiliary inversion.

questions.question: In no circumstances ___ these figures be altered after publication.
questions.explanation: Negative fronted adverbials such as in no circumstances trigger subject–auxiliary inversion.
